translations.text: The wise person’s eyes are in his head, but the fool walks in darkness. And I too realized that the same fate will meet them all.
For neither the wise person nor the fool is remembered forever, since in the days to come everything is forgotten. And how will the wise person die along with the fool?
I also saw under the sun that an ungodly person was in the place of judgment, and that a godly person was in the place of the righteous person.
And who knows whether the spirit of human beings will go up to heaven, and whether the spirit of an animal will go down to the earth?
And I praised all the dead, who had already died, more than the living, who are still alive now.
And I turned to futility under the sun.
It is better not to make a vow than to make a vow and not fulfill it.
For everyone to whom God has given wealth and possessions, and the power to eat from them, receive his share, and rejoice in his labor—this is a gift from God.
And it became very far from me, farther than it had been. And its depth was great. Who can reach it?
When flying flies die, they spoil the perfumer’s preparation of oil. The word of wisdom is more highly valued than the day of great foolishness.
And when a fool walks along a road, he will lack understanding, and everything he thinks about is foolishness.
Cast your bread upon the surface of the water, for you will find it after many days.
On the day when those who guard the house tremble, and the strong men bend over, and those who grind stop because they have become few, and the women who look through a window grow dark.
